brand_tagline: Local upscaling · images never leave this machine
denoise_conservative_hint: Smallest change, keeps the original texture
stage_drop_invalid: PNG / JPEG / WebP / BMP images only.
stage_compare_hint: Drag the divider to compare detail
stage_engine_requirements: Needs a browser with SIMD and threads; iOS is not supported.
stage_error_busy: The engine is still finishing the previous image.
stage_error_oom: Out of memory. Reload the page and try again.
about_lead: Real-CUGAN is a general anime image super-resolution model trained on a million-scale dataset, structurally compatible with Waifu2x.
about_p1: This project compiles ncnn and Real-CUGAN to WebAssembly with Emscripten and runs inference on the CPU in the browser, so nothing is uploaded and no server compute is involved.
about_p2: Because of weight size and memory limits it bundles the three 2X denoise profiles and the 3X denoise weights.
about_stack_web_value: Vite · React · TanStack Router / Query · Tailwind CSS · shadcn/ui · Paraglide JS
about_stack_deploy_value: A static site, with a Cloudflare Workers config included
about_credits: The model is Real-CUGAN by bilibili/ailab, the inference framework is Tencent/ncnn, and the toolchain is Emscripten.
